reading.title: Cleaning Items: Home Bathroom Check
reading.text: Mariam puts on gloves and fills a bucket with water. A sponge, brush and cloth are ready; a closed spray bottle, plunger, squeegee and tissue box stay on the shelf. Her routine list says: wash hands, brush teeth, take a shower, dry off, flush and comb hair. The verbs apply lotion and gargle describe other personal-care actions.
reading.imageBrief: Cleaning cupboard with gloves, bucket, sponge, brush, cloth, plunger, squeegee and closed spray bottle. No mixed chemicals, unsafe electricity or implied medical instruction.

exercises.prompt:
Mariam fills the bucket, wets the sponge, and scrubs the bath with a brush.
Based on the situation, which option best fits what the person is doing, using, or needs?

Omar wears gloves, sprays the mirror with a spray bottle, and wipes it with a cloth.
What does Omar use to wipe the mirror?

A plunger has a suction cup for clearing some blocked drains. The squeegee removes water from glass, while a tissue is disposable paper.
Which tool has a suction cup?

Maya describes her routine: “I wash my hands with soap and water. I brush my teeth before bed and take a shower before work.”
Which phrase means cleaning the hands with soap and water?

Hana says, “After washing, I dry off and comb my hair. I flush the toilet after using it.” A comb arranges the hair.
Which phrase names arranging hair with a comb?

Rana says, “I apply lotion to my hands.” Apply lotion means putting the product on skin. Gargle is a different action involving liquid at the back of the mouth.
Which phrase means putting lotion onto skin?

Read the passage: Mariam puts on gloves and fills a bucket with water. A sponge, brush and cloth are ready; a closed spray bottle, plunger, squeegee and tissue box stay on the shelf. Her routine list says: wash hands, brush teeth, take a shower, dry off, flush and comb hair. The verbs apply lotion and gargle describe other personal-care actions.
What does Mariam fill with water?
Ask where the cleaning gloves are stored.
Explain what comb hair means using a complete sentence.
exercises.answer: Comb hair means arranging hair with a comb.
